command.doc: dispatch one command to the service; `state print` returns the model, `wait`/`ui dump`/`quit` are refused (front-end verbs)

line.doc: one line of the cosmo command grammar (R-SVC-5): project open | project new | project save [path.cmp] | project close | import [img ...] | select [add|range] | select next | select prev | set = [key=value ...] | bypass on|off | group new ["name"] | group ungroup | group rename [] "name" | delete [] | mask set = [key=value ...] | mask delete | undo | redo | preset apply "" | preset save "" | export --outdir [--format jpg|png|tiff] [--quality N] [--long-edge N] | settings set cpuPercent=N previewEdge=N threads=N useGpu=0|1 | screen home|editor | state print [--json] | ui dump [--json] [--visible] [--depth N] | wait load.finished|export.finished|quit| [--timeout 120s] (hyphens accepted) | wb pick --x X --y Y (0..1 of the photo) | metadata [] | gesture on|off | quit

command.result: {revision} - or the model for `state print`; a rejection fails with lastError

model.doc: the whole AppModel as JSON, params included

controls.doc: the Basic/Detail slider catalogue; `stops` sample track -> engine units
controls.result: [{title, whiteBalancePicker, controls: [{label, field, min, max, stops, rampFrom?, rampTo?}]}]

commands.doc: the command grammar: every command name with its argument hint

thumbs.doc: send filmstrip thumbnails to the caller on the `thumb` stream

node.doc: only this node (default: every decoded image)

frame.doc: send the newest preview to the caller on the `preview` stream

browse.doc: list a folder of the board: sub-folders, projects (.cmp) and images

path.doc: folder to list (default: the home folder)

browse.result: {path, parent, entries: [{name, path, kind: dir|project|image, size?}]}
